content.value: A centrifugal pump lifts water against a static head of 40 m, of which 4 m is suction lift. The suction and delivery pipes are both 150 mm in diameter, the head loss in the suction pipe is 2.3 m and in the delivery pipe, 7.4 m. The impeller is 420 mm in diameter and 25 mm width at the mouth; it revolves at 1200 rpm and its effective vane angle at exit is 35°. If $\eta _ { \mathrm { { m a n o } } } = 8 2 \%$ and $\eta _ { \mathrm { o } } = 7 2 \%$ , determine the power required to drive the pump.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
